intro: Fiji has about 900,000 people of iTaukei, Indian and other descent.

chapters.title: People
text: About 60% are iTaukei and about a third Indo-Fijian. English, Fijian and Fiji Hindi are official. Christianity, Hinduism and Islam are all practised.

chapters.title: Suva
text: Suva, the capital, is the largest city in the South Pacific outside Australia and New Zealand.
